title: steffensia geniculata
intro: Steffensia geniculata, commonly known as Steffensia, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of fever, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as acting as an anti-inflammatory and antipyretic agent. The bioactive constituents present in Steffensia geniculata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
